description: IBCS line chart with scenario notation (EX 1.1 cards 12 and 15, UN 3.2): one continuous AC&FC line with filled dark square markers for AC and HATCHED markers for FC; PY light grey line with light markers; Plan (planLabel, default PL) dark line with HOLLOW (outlined) markers. Line thickness encodes the measure type (absolute = thick), not the scenario. Scenario names and values paired at the line ends with a minimum vertical gap; other primary values labelled above peaks and below valleys. Optional pxPerUnit joins a shared scale group.

fields.Period: text, category label; sort by period ascending
fields.FC: measure, forecast (optional; continues the AC line)
fields.PY: measure, previous year (optional, shown when showPY)
fields.PL: measure, plan/budget (optional, shown when showPL); bind the plan measure as PL and set planLabel for its displayed name

ibcs.notes: Follows the IBCS® Standards. planLabel names the measure bound as PL in the end label, tooltip and notation footnote; its markers stay hollow/outlined. For a relative measure (%, ratio) set measureType = 'relative': thin lines and % labels/tooltips (fractions, 0.42 = 42%). More than three crossing lines: use small multiples (EX 2.4). Blank Period rows and rows with AC, FC, PY and PL all null are dropped before ordering; a PY-only or PL-only row remains. End labels pair each scenario name with its last value in a shared right-hand column, separated by at least ibcsFontSize + 4 px; the last primary value is omitted from the peak/valley labels. pxPerUnit is pixels per display unit after unitDivisor (also per fraction for relative measures); 0 fits the data. For a scale group use the same positive pxPerUnit and size each container to its data range using layout; if too small, data wins and the actual scale shrinks. Trend arrow (UN 5.1): from the first to the last valid AC&FC value, parallel to the arithmetic change, lifted above all visible series. Polarity chooses colour only (1 / -1 / 0 = higher better / lower better / neutral). For absolute measures, 'delta' is relative change on the signed start (N/A when start <= 0 or blank); 'cagr' uses period steps (only meaningful for years; N/A unless both ends > 0). For relative measures, both 'delta' and 'cagr' show the arithmetic change in percentage points (pp), including zero/negative starts; CAGR falls back to pp delta. A trend rounding to zero at the displayed precision is unsigned and uncoloured. Raise trendLiftPx if needed. Render-checked outside Power BI; not verified in Desktop.

tiers.range: min(0, visible AC/FC/PY/PL divided by unitDivisor) … max(0, visible AC/FC/PY/PL divided by unitDivisor); with trendArrow use the envelope described in rule

layout.rule: At ibcsFontSize 12 with the plan footnote visible: container height = 46 + (hi - lo) * pxPerUnit + 2 * ibcsFontSize. Without the plan footnote (showPL false or no PL bound) subtract 24 px: fixedPxNoPlanFootnote; scale_layout.py uses it for a member with "planFootnote": false or params showPL false. Deneb uses a fixed container: size it from this data range, then the y domain spans plot height / pxPerUnit, with label padding in data units. A too-small container lets data win. With trendArrow and at least two primary values, let v0/v1 be its endpoints, e = max(0, max(visible row maximum - interpolated primary trend)); hi = max(base hi, max(v0,v1) + e + (ibcsFontSize + 10 + trendLiftPx + (trendLabel is nonempty ? ibcsFontSize + 10 : 4)) / pxPerUnit). Minimum plot height for three stacked end labels is 3 * (ibcsFontSize + 4). Recompute the fixed overhead for changed fonts.

params.name: showPY
params.description: draw the PY line (solid light) when PY is bound

params.name: showPL
params.description: draw the plan line (outlined markers, named by planLabel) when PL is bound

params.name: planLabel
params.description: Displayed name of the plan measure bound as PL, e.g. BU; used in the line-end label, tooltip and notation footnote. Plan markers remain hollow/outlined.

params.name: decimals
params.description: decimals for labels and tooltips (absolute: number format; relative: % format); IBCS: at most 3 digits in charts

params.name: unitDivisor
params.description: divides every value before drawing and labelling: 1 = the measures are already scaled (preferred, e.g. a scaled measure or a Scale picker), 1000 = thousands, 1000000 = millions. The unit belongs in the title (UN 2.2), never as K/M suffixes

params.name: pxPerUnit
params.description: Pixels per display unit after unitDivisor (per fraction for relative measures); 0 = fit. Use the same positive value on a scale group and size each container from usermeta.ibcs.layout. A too-small container lets the data win and reduces the actual pixels per unit.

params.name: trendArrow
params.description: draw a trend arrow (UN 5.1) from the first to the last value above the lines, coloured by polarity

params.name: trendLabel
params.description: '' hides the label; delta = relative change for absolute measures, arithmetic pp change for relative measures; cagr = CAGR for absolute measures, pp delta fallback for relative measures.

params.name: polarity
params.description: 1 higher is better, -1 lower is better, 0 neutral (blue): impact colour only, never the direction (a Polarity field per row wins where the template reads one)

params.name: trendLiftPx
params.description: extra px between the highest point and the trend arrow

layer.description: Invisible lower extent; no value axis, data labels instead. pxPerUnit > 0 removes scale padding and includes label room in the explicit domain.
Invisible upper extent: visible data, optional trend arrow and label; in fixed-scale mode the domain spans at least plot height / pxPerUnit.
selection (cross-filtering): assisting-area band behind every mark of the selected category; no mark is dimmed (a dimmed AC reads like PY)
category axis (base line at zero), drawn before the lines so every mark is in front of it
AC -> FC separator: a short tick on the category axis between the last AC and the first FC period (the same as the web components), never a line through the tiers, so no label crosses it
markers: FC hatched squares (outline + diagonal stripes drawn as a symbol path, so the hatch stays visible at marker size; Deneb's 10 px pattern tiles are larger than a marker)
Primary values above peaks and below valleys; the final value is paired with its scenario name in the end-label column.
End labels: names and values together, spaced at least ibcsFontSize + 4 px vertically; connectors identify displaced labels.

transform.filter: datum._i == datum._lastV || datum._i == datum._lastPY || datum._i == datum._lastPL
(datum._s == '_v' && datum._i == datum._lastV) || (datum._s == '_py' && showPY && datum._i == datum._lastPY) || (datum._s == '_pl' && showPL && datum._i == datum._lastPL)

transform.calculate: datum._rank == 1 ? datum._px : (datum._rank == 2 ? max(datum._px, datum._l1 + ibcsFontSize + 4) : max(datum._px, datum._l1 + ibcsFontSize + 4, datum._l2 + 2 * (ibcsFontSize + 4)))

layer.description: trend arrow (UN 5.1, F3): thick arrow from the first to the last period of the AC&FC series, parallel to first→last and lifted above every point, head in time direction, colour = impact of the change (polarity)
trend arrow head, rotated to the arrow's pixel slope

angle.expr: atan2(scale('y', datum._a1) - scale('y', datum._a0), scale('x', datum.Period) - scale('x', datum._tp0)) * 180 / PI

layer.description: Trend label: relative measures use pp delta, including CAGR fallback; absolute measures use relative change or CAGR.
Plan notation footnote uses the same planLabel as the line-end name; the data field remains PL.
